profile.headline: Software Engineer at Leidos
profile.summary:
Analyst experience developing qualitative and quantitative analyses to assist customers and stakeholders in identifying and implementing technology and business processes to reduce costs. Extensive knowledge of business intelligence report generation and information system management. Excellent customer service record, continually discovering new paths to contribute to overall program objectives. Clear communicator to all organizational levels.

Specialties: 
•SQL
•IBM Cognos BI
•MS Office Suite
•Data mapping
•Data visualization
•Business intelligence report development
•Security+ CE
•Active Secret clearance

positions.title: Field Engineer Principal - Team Lead
positions.description:
• Lead Engineer over a team of 6 NiFi engineers
• Utilizing Apache NiFi to facilitate file movement from On-Prem systems, commercial cloud entities, and other government cloud entities into USAF Cloud One provider environments
• Migration lead point of contact for technical information
• Initial customer point of contact for Data Transport 
• Tier 2+ support for Mission System data transport issues
• Apache NiFi SME

positions.title: Field Engineer Principal
positions.description:
• Supported all facets of the United States Marine Corps (USMC), Manpower and Reserve Affairs, in regards to personnel records. 
• Provided guidance and consultation in regards to records protection policies. 
• Accountable for abiding by policy when disseminating sensitive records to protect personally identifiable information (PII). 
• Created and maintained an Access Control List for users of the web reporting tool and for users with a direct database connection. 
• Provided consultation to users to develop the best method for pulling and delivering records to protect sensitive data. 
• Provided technical assistance as well as guidance on requirements gathering in order to fulfill requests for information. 
• Supervised Service Desk staff. 
• Subject Matter Expert (SME) in support of qualitative analyses of manpower statistical records, research studies, and Naval Postgraduate School thesis data. 
• Evaluated new data sources or new data from existing sources.
• Data mapping.
• Data validation.
• Created/modified data packages in Cognos BI by adding or removing data tables, defining relationships, and defining dependencies.
• Created/modified OLAP cubes using Cognos Transformer from multiple data sources. 
• Development of complex Report Studio reports involving drill up, drill down and master/detail querying of personnel records. Post implementation support and modification of existing commercial off-the-shelf data warehousing and analytics solutions. 
• Provided phone support and desk-side training to end users. 
• Liaison between the customer and the supporting IT team for upper-tier support to end users. 
• Managed all requests for data/information throughout all Marine Corps Organizations, Department of Defense agencies, and government contractors. 
• Supervised and provided analytical support for all data mining and data scientists. 
• Provided information security and assurance knowledge to ensure a high level of cyber security across all systems.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Supported the Department of Defense (DoD) ongoing Travel Information Management System.
•	Provided additional enhancements to the Data Management Portal and other applications to meet the deliverables required by the Defense Travel Management Office. 
•	Provided reports of DoD travel records that included commercial travel of DoD employees as well as financial records from the DoD travel charge cards. 
•	Led travel management and statistical report development and analysis to provide DoD the necessary travel records while protecting the sensitive nature of those records. 
•	Supported data quality program efforts.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed the implementation of mobile travel support tools for global clients of a major business travel management company. 
•	Developed an implementation project plan to ensure proper deployment of the mobility solution. 
•	Developed a process flow to further define the steps required for end-to-end implementation. 
•	Served as technical point of contact, liaison with mobility vendors. 
•	Worked with key stakeholders to give status updates, gather requirements and support user acceptance testing.

positions.title: Implementation Manager
positions.description:
•	Implemented CWT Sato's E-Gov Travel Service (ETS) system onsite at federal agency clients. 
•	Met with each sub-agency (bureau/operational division) implementation team and key senior management stakeholders to communicate the implementation objectives and requirements, develop migration plans, and gather data required for implementation. 
•	Reviewed and analyzed required data and format for loading to the ETS system. 
•	Developed and maintained project plan and provided updates to Program Manager and Contracting Officer's Technical Representative on implementation status. 
•	Developed internal agency ETS communications to include memorandum to end users, travel administrators as well as senior management. 
•	Presented and demonstrated the ETS application ("E2 Solutions”) for all travelers, travel arrangers, and mid- and senior-level approving officials. 
•	Conducted training classes for the Travel Management Company’s (TMC) web-based reporting tool (“Discovery”). 
•	Compiled reference documents for Discovery training attendees and key points of contact for web-based reporting tool. 
•	Developed a system in Microsoft Access to conduct additional analyses and to report on data extracted from the TMC reporting tool.

positions.title: Senior Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed travel management, financial analysis, and traveler activity reports for use in proprietary web-based applications using Actuate e.Report Designer. 
•	Supported Account Managers serving Agencies of the Federal Government including the Departments of State, Labor, Interior, and Defense and the General Services Administration (GSA). 
•	Developed and maintained reports in compliance with GSA master contract and Federal Travel Regulation (FTR) as well as custom report development. 
•	Subject matter expert and point of contact for all facets of reporting company wide. 
•	Met with clients to gather reporting requirements. 
•	Presented and demonstrated the reporting module of the web-based travel application ("E2 Solutions”) as well as the traditional travel management reporting web application (“Discovery”). 
•	Liaison with development teams supporting the traditional travel reporting site at Carlson Wagonlit Travel headquarters in Minneapolis, MN. 
•	Liaison with E2 Solutions development team for CW Government Travel in San Antonio, TX. 
•	Developed reports customized to individual clients' needs. 
•	Supported Finance with monthly and quarterly transaction reports used to state performance to GSA's E Travel System Program Management Office (eTS PMO). 
•	Evaluated data integrity to ensure that GDS scripts were running properly and all necessary data elements were being captured. 
•	Tested eTS reports to certify database changes due to application enhancements. 
•	Participated in software testing scenarios. 
•	Entered defects found into Quality Center and routed accordingly. 
•	Closed reporting-related defects with resolution or updated defects with proposed solution and re-routed as required.

positions.title: E-Com Reporting Manager
positions.description:
•	Developed travel management reports and generated useful analyses of travel trends and cost comparisons for corporate clients. 
•	Gave guidance to and support 15 Reporting Analysts and 80 Account Managers serving 250 commercial clients, each generating from $500,000 to over $10M in annual travel expenses. 
•	Met with clients to assess reporting needs. 
•	Advised on travel management tools, explained features and benefits of various options. 
•	Explained comparative analysis reports available for evaluating/reducing costs and measuring performance against budgets and objectives. 
•	Worked with source and/or software vendors to resolve inconsistencies, standardized reporting/data, or built custom import procedures. 
•	Consolidated data from multiple sources for clients to provide all-inclusive reports. 
•	Tested and fine-tuned to ensure client received useful, accurate data. 
•	Generated daily and weekly reports, inspecting data for accuracy to maintain quality assurance standards. 
•	Emailed results to designated stakeholders. 
•	Established user accounts and permissions for web reporting modules. 
•	Configured desktop reporting software. 
•	Trained clients on use of software and web systems. 
•	Subject matter expert regarding databases, Hi-Mark Software, system capacity and functionality. 
•	Performed remote and on-site troubleshooting to quickly resolve processing issues and investigate irregular reports, examining data and query processes to identify and repair causes for error.

positions.title: Project Manager-Reporting Tool Implementations
positions.description:
•	Implemented third-party reporting software (Hi-Mark Software) to report across a variety of applications' databases. 
•	Direct involvement with the implementation by aiding in database development, initial creation of relational data dictionary, design of initial set of reports, installation and initial administration-user setup of web reporting application, installation and training of end-users. 
•	Escalation point for support and troubleshooting of the reporting tool, which included report building, query writing, report design (using Paradox 8), and supporting the web-based application version of same reporting tool for company-wide MIS reporting departments. 
•	Acted as the liaison with IT and DBAs on any SQL Server 2000 database issues, maintenance, creation as it relates to MIS reporting support using SQL Server client tools (Enterprise Manager, Query Analyzer) and for any network-related issues (email, connectivity, "DMZ" security issues) as it pertains to the reporting servers. 
•	Performed data imports, report building, and support for company-wide consolidated database.

positions.title: Reporting Analyst
positions.description:
•	Supported company-wide MIS departments with client reporting tool, back office, and SQL Server database questions, troubleshooting, training, and system upgrades. 
•	Processed and maintained data flow into a consolidated client database.

positions.title: Data/Reporting Analyst
positions.description:
•	Generated business intelligence reports for travel service companies including Expedia and Continental Airlines. 
•	Identified necessary data and reporting fields for requested reports. 
•	Imported and standardized data from multiple, diverse reporting sources to consolidate into one production-reporting database. 
•	Wrote custom queries. 
•	Inspected data for irregularities; analyzed sources to quickly resolve issues. 
•	Reports included tracking of tickets from booking to delivery, breakdown of booking sources with price/type for each, and trending reports showing commonalities. 
•	Key contributor to migration from Hi-Mark systems to Actuate software. 
•	Set up tests and inspected results for quality assurance.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
•	Maintained database and software; performed remote and on-site troubleshooting to resolve issues. 
•	Worked with software vendors to maximize functionality and implement upgrades. 
•	Developed and presented "Train the Trainer" sessions for all MIS departments. 
•	Designed curriculum and training collateral including quick reference guides for both desktop reporting tools and web modules. 
•	Designed and conducted IT training covering installation, configuration, troubleshooting and support.
